name: go-security-audit
description: > Security review for Go applications: input validation, SQL injection, authentication/authorization, secrets management, TLS, OWASP Top 10, and secure coding patterns. Use when performing security reviews, checking for vulnerabilities, hardening Go services, or reviewing auth implementations. Trigger examples: "security review", "check vulnerabilities", "OWASP", "SQL injection", "input validation", "secrets management", "auth review". Not for: dependency CVEs (go-dependency-audit), concurrency
author: eduardo-sl
